'''The Dagger''' was a battle tactic used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]]. It was also known as the '''Mercevian Nagua maneuver''' after the pirate [[Mercevian Nagua]] who favored the tactic. Essentially a variation of [[the Barricade]], the Dagger called for a [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] to infiltrate the target [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] with the intention of disabling the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. This allowed the saboteur to force the ship from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] at a prearranged location. The Dagger was favored by privateer crews as it often accomplished the capture of a vessel quickly. Additionally, saboteurs caught in the act were usually only arrested.<ref name="PP" />

A variation of the Dagger involved targeting ships with large, transient crew rosters and placing a number of infiltrators among the crew. Once on board, the infiltrators would seize the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], essentially hijacking the ship in transit.<ref name="PP" />
